'''2003 Virginia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG [[Classic]] state championship in Virginia (7 June 2003).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Classic]] format<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Site:''' Virginia
* '''Dates:''' 7 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Groovy Gecko's, Williamsburg, Virginia<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Derek Brooks]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Paul Evans]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
